primary.title: ₹100 daily vs ₹3,000 monthly SIP in mutual funds: Which investment helps you build bigger money corpus in 5, 10, 15 yrs?
primary.summary: A ₹100 daily SIP and a ₹3,000 monthly SIP may seem similar, but their investment amounts and final values differ over time. Here's how both could grow over 5, 10, and 15 years, assuming 12% annualised returns, and what investors should consider before choosing between them.
